releases.notes:
Added:
- CS:GO Knives (Items) - 20 different CS:GO-style knives for Custom Items, in a realistic 3D style with procedural skins or a Minecraft pixel style
- CS:GO Hand (Items) - hold your knife with minecraft hand 
- Inspect animations (Items) - new inspects for every knife and a lightsaber one
- Third Person (Items) - see inspect animations in third person
- Shared Custom Items (Items) - QZA users see each other's custom items and inspect animations live
- Texturepack Combiner (Items) - mix blocks, items, GUI and HUD, and sky and effects from your own packs, with a colour Theme that beats any other pack (hearts too)
- Announce Leap (Dungeons) - says "Leaped to <ign>"  in party chat after you leap, or shows it only to you
- Leap Keybinds (Dungeons) - leap with a key for each corner of the leap menu or for each class
- Force Paul (Notifications) - Dungeon Score always counts Paul's +10. Without it, QZA now also notices when Jerry's Perkpocalypse is on Paul's perks
- PreFire (QZA Cheats) - BloodCamp Triggerbot also clicks a skull's spawn box just before the timer hits 0

Fixed:
- Leap Menu (Dungeons) - leaping not working at all on 26.3
- Crystal Spawn Timer (Dungeons) - timer being off
- Player heads (Chat) - DM heads keep a player's skin 
- Music Player Overlay (Miscellaneous) - shows the song length for players
- Karambit (Items) - attacking doesn't punch forward as much

Changed:
- Items tab - item features from Inventory and Miscellaneous now live together in a new Items tab
- Inspect Item (Items) - each item type has one animation now
- Open Where Last Closed (Miscellaneous) - remembers where you were until you restart
- Aim at Melody (QZA Cheats) - renamed from Melody

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MullyGoat/QZA/compare/v1.4.9...v1.5.0

releases.notes:
Added:
- Leap Menu (Dungeons) - leap Menu but with good custom order feature
- Leap Order (Dungeons) - custom Sorting has an editor that previews the menu: drag the classes where you want them and save a different order for each class you play
- Relic Spawn Timer (Dungeons) - countdown for when relics spawn
- Inspect Item (Miscellaneous) - press a key to inspect the item in your hand, with options to show your hand, change the speed and keep playing while you swing.
- Custom Items (Inventory) - turn any SkyBlock item into a karambit, butterfly knife or lightsaber. Cool customizable lightsaber modes and able to change material of karambit / butterfly knife
- Open Where Last Closed (Miscellaneous) - "/qza" opens on the tab, scroll spot, open cards and search you closed it on

Fixed:

Changed:
- Dungeons tab - the F7 / M7 tab is now called Dungeons

releases.notes:
Added:
- Blood Camp Tracker (F7 / M7) - shows where each blood mob will land with a countdown until it spawns, a timer for when the Watcher moves, and a pink "Kill Mobs" alert.
- Gate Destroyed Alert (F7 / M7) - shows a red "Gate Destroyed" on screen
- Alert Duration (F7 / M7) - slider for how long the Terminal Tracker's section alerts stay on screen, 2 seconds by default
- Item Glow (Miscellaneous) - makes the item in your hand glow with the Aura, Shimmer or Flame style. Option to choose any color, Rainbow or the item's SkyBlock rarity, with speed, brightness, and static settings. Works with any texture pack.
- Sword Blocking (Miscellaneous) - brings back the 1.8 sword blocking animation when you hold right-click with a sword, with the blocking arm in third person and on other players who block
- Terminator Indicator (Inventory) - shows whether you are holding your Soul Eater or Duplex Terminator. Can show item name on screen, put a coloured dot on the item, or both. Rename them, change their colour, or manually pick which term is which.
- Inventory tab - the item and inventory features moved here from Miscellaneous
- Hide Background (Miscellaneous) - Music Player Overlay option to hide the box behind the song's title, artist and length

Fixed:
- Terminal Tracker (F7 / M7) - "S1 Done!" and the other section alerts no longer vanish after a split second when another title shows
- QZA menu - the tab list no longer runs off the bottom of the menu in small windows
- BloodCamp Triggerbot (QZA Cheats) - fixed clicking at wrong time which left mob alive

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MullyGoat/QZA/compare/v1.4.7...v1.4.8

releases.notes:
Added:
- Item Prices (Miscellaneous) - item tooltips show item prices
- Full Bright (Miscellaneous) - Lights up room with settings like Ambient Light, Brightness or Night Vision. Ability hide a real Night Vision effect while it's on
- Recorded Speed (QZA Cheats) - "/qza recorder" now shows the speed each recording was made at
- Menu Pause (QZA Cheats) - opening a menu during a Movement Copier playback now pauses it, and it carries on when the menu closes instead of stopping. inventory key no longer stops a playback
- BloodCamp Triggerbot Pre-Fire (QZA Cheats) - now clicks 1 tick before Odin's or NoammAddons' blood camp timer hits 0 if you're aiming at the spawn box. If misses then it'll click again for you

Fixed:
- Terminal Tracker (F7 / M7) - no notification when sections were finished
- DM History (Chat) - offline accounts are not shown when looking at other account DMs
- Music Player Overlay (Miscellaneous) - the controls now show in your own inventory, crafting tables and furnaces, not only in chest menus
- Music Player Overlay (Miscellaneous) - the progress bar no longer disappears when an app briefly stops reporting the song's length
- Movement Copier (QZA Cheats) - aim corrections now ease in instead of snapping the camera

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MullyGoat/QZA/compare/v1.4.6...v1.4.7

releases.notes:
Added:
- BloodCamp Triggerbot (QZA Cheats) - left clicks after a blood mob spawns, but only while it's still in the air and you're looking at it.  Has a Range slider (default 20 blocks) and an optional item whitelist
- Item Protection (Miscellaneous) - stops the items you protect from being dropped, sold to NPCs, salvaged, traded, auctioned or put in item frames, and marks them with a pink star in the corner you pick. Protect the item you're holding or hovering with the Protect Key or "/qza protect"
- Section Done Alert (F7 / M7) - the Terminal Tracker now shows "S1 Done!" (up to S4) with a ding and can say it in party chat too
- Legit Align (QZA Cheats) - walking into a Movement Copier ring during a boss now walks you to the exact center of the block before the route starts
- Start Turn Speed and Overshoot (QZA Cheats) - choose how fast the camera turns to a recording's starting view, and whether it overshoots and by how much

Fixed:
- Score Display (Dungeons) - no longer jumps around when the room count and cleared percentage update at different times
- Match Recorded Speed (QZA Cheats) - now slows you down by letting go of your movement keys for a tick whenever you get ahead of the route, instead of weakening them

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MullyGoat/QZA/compare/v1.4.4...v1.4.5
